sentences.translation: 止血笔（用止血剂制成的药棒，如用于刮脸时划破之处）。

sentences.sentence: Objective: To evaluate hemostatic effects and safety of the soluble styptic gauze made by hydroxyethyl cellulose.
sentences.translation: 目的：考察羟乙基改性纤维素可溶性纱布的止血效果及安全性。

sentences.sentence: And any gentleman who’s ever beenbackhanded by a lady with her diamond ring should know a styptic pencil willstop the bleeding.
sentences.translation: 那些被戴着钻戒的女士们反手扇过耳光的先生们应该知道止血笔是管用的。

sentences.sentence: Every linguistic category is a polysemous category, or it is one that contains several potential senses.
sentences.translation: 每一个语言范畴都是多义范畴，至少是具有数个潜势义项的多义范畴。

sentences.sentence: How to provide the effective strategy of teaching meanings will contribute to the guessing and retention of the figurative senses of polysemous words.
sentences.translation: 因此，如何提供有效的词义教学策略将有助于大学生对多义词比喻意义的猜测和学习。

sentences.sentence: The existence of polysemous words in Russian not only reflects such tendency but also provides broader context for the study of meaning transference of nouns.
sentences.translation: 现代俄语中大量多义词的存在既从不同侧面反映了这一趋势，又为进一步研究名词转义提供了更为广阔的天地。

sentences.sentence: In addition, the enzyme activity of high yield female plant, low yield female plant and acarpous female plant were compared.
sentences.translation: 此外，还比较了高产、低产、不结果雌株之间同工酶的酶带和活性差别。

sentences.sentence: In addition, the isozyme bands and enzyme activity of high yield female plant, low yield female plant and acarpous female plant were compared.
sentences.translation: 此外，还比较了高产、低产、不结果雌株之间同工酶的酶带和活性差别。

sentences.sentence: Doubling of chromosomes improved the meiosis obviously, but tetraploid hybrid was still acarpous which may be related to the nucleo-cytoplasmic incompatibility.
sentences.translation: 染色体加倍明显改善了杂种的减数分裂，但杂种四倍体仍不能结实，推测杂种的不育性很可能与核质亲和性有关。

sentences.sentence: Conclusion The cephalic vein or basilic vein in the elbow can be chosen for centripetal puncture during the early period of arteriovenous internal fistula in hemodialysis patients.
sentences.translation: 结论血液透析患者动静脉内瘘早期启用可选择肘部头静脉或贵要静脉向心方向穿刺。

sentences.sentence: Objective To investigate the feasibility of exposing cephalic vein with horizontal incision on the chest and the successful rate of implanting pacing leads using guide wire and split sheath.
sentences.translation: 目的探索经胸横切口暴露头静脉及使用导引钢丝、静脉鞘管引导放置起搏电极导线的成功率及临床意义。

sentences.sentence: If she doesn't turn in the next week or so, your doctor may attempt to turn her manually by manipulating your abdomen from the outside in a procedure called "external cephalic version" (ECV).
sentences.translation: 如果在接下来的几周还没有转过来，你的医生可能尝试通过在外部操纵你的腹部人工来改变婴儿的位置，这一过程补称作外倒转术。

text:
英语词汇 · GRE · 第 4 单元

titanic
adj. [化](含)钛的, 四价钛的
例句：a titanic struggle
大搏斗

subcutaneous
音标：英 /,sʌbkjuː'teɪnɪəs/  美 /,sʌbkjʊ'tenjəs/
adj. [解] 皮下的, 皮下用的
短语：subcutaneous tissue — 皮下组织
短语：subcutaneous injection — [医]皮下注射
短语：subcutaneous fat — 皮下脂肪
短语：subcutaneous emphysema — 皮下气肿
例句：subcutaneous fat
皮下脂肪

vascular
音标：英 /'væskjʊlə/  美 /'væskjəlɚ/
adj. [解][动]脉管的, 有脉管的, 血管的
短语：vascular disease — 血管疾病
短语：vascular dementia — n. 血管性痴呆；血管型失智症
短语：vascular bundle — [植]维管束
短语：vascular tissue — 维管组织；血管组织；脉管组织
短语：vascular resistance — 血管阻力
短语：vascular system — 血管系统；维管系
短语：peripheral vascular disease — 周围性血管疾病
短语：vascular plant — 维管植物；导管植物
短语：vascular cambium — 维管形成层；维管束形成层
短语：vascular bed — [医]血管床
例句：vascular disease
脉管疾病

terricolous
音标：英 /te'rɪkələs/
adj. [生]陆生的
例句：An earthworm is a terricolous organism.
蚯蚓是陆生的生物。
例句：Ferns were the first terricolous vascular plants, and still comprise an important part of primary productivity of ecosystems.
蕨类植物是最早登陆的维管植物，至今仍然是生态系统初级生产力的重要组成部分。
例句：The vertical variation is that there are many autogenic carbonate sediments in the earlier period and that terricolous sediments are dominant in the later period.
纵向上呈现出由早期有较多内源碳酸盐沉积到晚期以大量陆源物为主的变化。

embryonic
音标：英 /,embrɪ'ɒnɪk/  美 /,ɛmbrɪ'ɑnɪk/
adj. [生]胚胎的, 开始的
短语：embryonic development — 胚胎发育
短语：embryonic stage — 胚[胎]期
短语：embryonic cell — 胚细胞
短语：embryonic period — 胚胎期
例句：embryonic development
胚胎的发育
例句：embryonic cells
胚胎细胞

photophilous
音标：英 /fəʊ'tɒfɪləs/  美 /fəu'tɔfiləs/
adj. [生]喜光的,嗜光的,适光的

osseous
音标：英 /'ɒsɪəs/  美 /'ɑsɪəs/
adj. [生化]骨的, 骨质的
短语：osseous tissue — 骨组织
例句：The majority of jawbone intra-osseous lipomas are found in adults, and of uncertain origin and etiology but are usually associated with molar teeth.
大部份颚骨的骨内脂肪瘤被发现于成年人，而其来源及病因不明，但通常与大臼齿有关。
例句：Extraction of proteins from extensively calcified osseous tissue, such as cortical bone has been particularly challenging for traditional methods of sample preparation.
从皮质骨等充分钙化的骨质组织中提取蛋白的方法极大地挑战了传统的样品制备方法。

generic
音标：英 /dʒɪ'nerɪk/  美 /dʒə'nɛrɪk/
adj. [生物]属的, 类的, 一般的, 普通的, 非特殊的
短语：generic term — 通用术语；地理通名
短语：generic type — 类属型
短语：generic name — 属名；总名称；通用名称
短语：generic algorithm — n. 泛型算法；通用算法
短语：generic drug — 学名药；通用名药；副厂药
短语：generic programming — 泛型编程；范型程序设计
例句：Parmesan is a generic term used to describe a family of hard Italian cheeses.
巴尔马干酪是一个用来描述一类坚硬的意大利奶酪的通用名称。

glabrous
音标：英 /'gleɪbrəs/  美 /'glebrəs/
adj. [生物]无毛的, 光洁的
例句：a glabrous stem

antenatal
音标：英 /æntɪ'neɪt(ə)l/  美 /'æntə'netl/
adj. [医]出生前的
例句：an antenatal clinic
产前检查诊所
例句：regular antenatal care
定期产前保健
例句：Many young mothers do not attend antenatal classes .
许多年轻的母亲不参加产前学习班。

allergic
音标：英 /ə'lɜːdʒɪk/  美 /ə'lɝdʒɪk/
adj. [医]过敏的, 患过敏症的
短语：allergic rhinitis — 过敏性鼻炎
短语：allergic reaction — 过敏反应；变态反应
短语：allergic asthma — [医]变应性气喘；敏性气喘
短语：allergic purpura — 过敏性紫癜
短语：allergic disease — 变应性疾病，变态反应病
短语：allergic contact dermatitis — 变应性接触性皮炎；过敏性接触性皮炎
短语：allergic dermatitis — 变应性皮炎
例句：an allergic reaction to nuts
对坚果的过敏性反应

rickety
音标：英 /'rɪkɪtɪ/  美 /'rɪkəti/
adj. [医]患佝偻病的, 驼背的, 摇摆的
例句：a rickety old wooden chair
一把摇摇晃晃的旧木椅

styptic
adj. [医]收敛性的, 止血的
例句：A styptic pencil, IE a stick of this, used eg on a cut made while shaving.
止血笔（用止血剂制成的药棒，如用于刮脸时划破之处）。
例句：Objective: To evaluate hemostatic effects and safety of the soluble styptic gauze made by hydroxyethyl cellulose.
目的：考察羟乙基改性纤维素可溶性纱布的止血效果及安全性。
例句：And any gentleman who’s ever beenbackhanded by a lady with her diamond ring should know a styptic pencil willstop the bleeding.
那些被戴着钻戒的女士们反手扇过耳光的先生们应该知道止血笔是管用的。

polysemous
adj. [语]一词多义的,多义的
例句：Every linguistic category is a polysemous category, or it is one that contains several potential senses.
每一个语言范畴都是多义范畴，至少是具有数个潜势义项的多义范畴。
例句：How to provide the effective strategy of teaching meanings will contribute to the guessing and retention of the figurative senses of polysemous words.
因此，如何提供有效的词义教学策略将有助于大学生对多义词比喻意义的猜测和学习。
例句：The existence of polysemous words in Russian not only reflects such tendency but also provides broader context for the study of meaning transference of nouns.
现代俄语中大量多义词的存在既从不同侧面反映了这一趋势，又为进一步研究名词转义提供了更为广阔的天地。

acarpous
音标：英 /eɪ'kɑːpəs/  美 /e'kɑrpəs/
adj. [植]不结果的,无果实的
例句：In addition, the enzyme activity of high yield female plant, low yield female plant and acarpous female plant were compared.
此外，还比较了高产、低产、不结果雌株之间同工酶的酶带和活性差别。
例句：In addition, the isozyme bands and enzyme activity of high yield female plant, low yield female plant and acarpous female plant were compared.
此外，还比较了高产、低产、不结果雌株之间同工酶的酶带和活性差别。
例句：Doubling of chromosomes improved the meiosis obviously, but tetraploid hybrid was still acarpous which may be related to the nucleo-cytoplasmic incompatibility.
染色体加倍明显改善了杂种的减数分裂，但杂种四倍体仍不能结实，推测杂种的不育性很可能与核质亲和性有关。

cephalic
音标：英 /sɪ'fælɪk; ke-/  美 /sɪ'fælɪk/
adj. [字尾]头的
例句：Conclusion The cephalic vein or basilic vein in the elbow can be chosen for centripetal puncture during the early period of arteriovenous internal fistula in hemodialysis patients.
结论血液透析患者动静脉内瘘早期启用可选择肘部头静脉或贵要静脉向心方向穿刺。
例句：Objective To investigate the feasibility of exposing cephalic vein with horizontal incision on the chest and the successful rate of implanting pacing leads using guide wire and split sheath.
目的探索经胸横切口暴露头静脉及使用导引钢丝、静脉鞘管引导放置起搏电极导线的成功率及临床意义。
例句：If she doesn't turn in the next week or so, your doctor may attempt to turn her manually by manipulating your abdomen from the outside in a procedure called "external cephalic version" (ECV).
如果在接下来的几周还没有转过来，你的医生可能尝试通过在外部操纵你的腹部人工来改变婴儿的位置，这一过程补称作外倒转术。

risque
音标：英 /ris'kei/
adj. <法> (作品等)淫秽的, 败坏风俗的

flippant
音标：英 /'flɪp(ə)nt/  美 /'flɪpənt/
adj. <古>能说会道的, 轻率的, 没礼貌的, 嘴碎的
例句：a rather flippant remark
相当轻浮的话

omnificent
音标：英 /ɒm'nɪfɪsənt/
adj. <罕>创造一切的, 有无限创造力的

mensal
音标：英 /'mensəl/
adj. <罕>每月一次的, 每月的, 餐桌的
